basic_info.description: Welcome to 330 Cornwall, a spectacular two-level penthouse masterfully crafted by architect Owen Kennerly. This residence is a true sanctuary in the sky, where sunlight pours in through an abundance of windows and skylights on every side, illuminating each room and framing sweeping, panoramic city views. The private 360-degree roof access is your very own oasis and sunset view. The entry level welcomes you with a tranquil primary suite, complete with a spa-inspired bathroom and generous closet space. A second bedroom and sleek nearby bath offer flexible comfort for guests or family. Ascend the dramatic staircase to the top floor, where soaring vaulted ceilings define the open living and dining area, seamlessly connected to a chic chef's kitchen featuring a central island and premium appliances. This level also offers a versatile third bedroom or home office and an additional full bath. Enjoy luxurious details including radiant floor heating, in-unit laundry, private outdoor decks off both the dining area and kitchen, secure parking, ICS6 in-ceiling speakers, & CAT6 wiring. Moments from Laurel Village, Clement Street shops, Golden Gate and Presidio Parks, this is not just a home, but a lifestyle elevated by design, warmth, and an unbeatable location.
